profile.jobTitle: Sr. Staff Embedded Software Engineer. Electric Power Coversion
profile.summary:
Embedded System Engineer (30year+)

Embedded system Designer/ Firmware Developer 
Microprocessor Application - Automation, Sensor Application

Freescale(NXP MPC5xxxx), TI-DSP, ADSP, ARM (Cortex), Infineon TC2xx, 3xx

C/C++, Eclipse,  Assembly, IDA disassembler

positions.title: Sr. Staff Embedded Software Engineer. Electric Power Coversion
positions.description:
Software Resolver Implementation: 
Developed and deployed the software-based resolver decoding algorithm across R1, R2, and EDV platforms, ensuring precise rotor position sensing and control responsiveness.

Steer-by-Wire (SbW) Control: 
Engineered core motor control software for the next-generation Steer-by-Wire system on the R2 900V architecture.

Ratiometric ADC Compensation: 
Synchronized ADC acquisition across 3-phase currents, DC-bus voltage, and sensor power supply rails, implementing real-time ratiometric compensation to eliminate measurement errors caused by supply drift.

positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Sr. Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
• Power Electronics, PMSM Driver Firmware.

• 500KW PEM for 60/30-ton combat vehicle
• NXP MPC5744P, OS-Less
• S32DS (Eclipse), C/C++

• NASA CO2 scrubber for ISS
• 60,000 RPM PMSDM, FOC
• NXP MPC5643L OS-Less
• S32DS (Eclipse)

• Baker Huge - General Electronics MCP, Deep-sea oil well pump
• NXP MPC5643L
• S32DS (Eclipse)

positions.title: Pricipal Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
•	BMW Engine Control Unit(ECU) Performance upgrading	
•	Reverse Engineering - Modify BMW ECU Authentication (RSA, MD5) 
& Replace calibration Data. More Engine power (+80hp)
•	Target Processor: NXP(Freescale) MPC5xx, Infineon TC17xx, Freescale(Motorola) 683xx
•	Tool: IDA Disassembler.

•	BMW Vehicle S/W Update system
•	OBD-II / OBD-Ethernet Communication: CAN, K-Line, Ethernet
•	Windows based Client 
•	Tool: Microsoft Visual studio (MFC/C++)

•	CAN Converter: CAN, K-Line OBD-II Communication Device
•	Arm7 (Atmel AT91SAM7X), USB CDC, RS-232C, USB 2.0
•	Schematic Entry / PCB Layout, Firmware Program.
•	Tool: Keil uVision(C/C++), OrCAD

•	DinanTronics: Engine Control Unit – Plug in (Piggyback) Controller
•	ECU add-on Controller, Modify Vehicle sensor signal (Pressure, Air Mass, Turbo Charger) to raise Power (ex. +80hp in 335i)
•	Processor: TMS570LS20216 (ARM Cortex R4F)
•	Analog/FM/PWM signal, Bluetooth 4.0 (Bluetooth Smart)
•	Tool: Keil uVision(C/C++), OrCAD
 
•	Calibration Map Editor for DinanTronics
•	Data Entry for DinanTronics
•	Microsoft Excel based Chart to Calibration Data conversion
•	Tool: Microsoft Visual C#
